transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, good day, esteemed customer! Welcome to Master Li's humble dispensary. How may this humble disciple assist you today? My master, the venerable Li, is currently out in the misty mountains, gathering the rarest of herbs. A truly magnificent harvest it will be, I'm sure!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! A fine 'dispensary' you have here! And what of your so-called 'master'? It seems you are no more than a charlatan, trying to pass off placebos as elixirs! Return my gold pieces, or I shall make this a most unpleasant visit for you!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My eyes widen slightly at the sudden bluster, but I quickly regain my composure, puffing out my chest just a little.)

A-a charlatan? My master, Li, is renowned throughout the nine provinces for his healing prowess! He is merely away, as I said, harvesting... very important, very potent herbs. As for your gold pieces... (I frown, crossing my arms.) We do not offer refunds, sir. Especially not for the Potion of Serene Slumber. It is well-known that the potion only works on those of pure heart – the fault, I'm afraid, lies with the customer's spiritual unworthiness, not the medicine. There are no refunds for the spiritually impure.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ha! Spiritually impure? A fine excuse! I am Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and I have taken countless elixirs in my time! Your potion is naught but watered-down tea! Return my coins, or I shall reduce your 'dispensary' to kindling!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My jaw drops a little, and my eyes dart around nervously, though I try to maintain a brave front. Sun Wukong? The Great Sage? Oh dear. This is far above my pay grade.)

The... the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? (I swallow hard, my voice a little squeakier than before.) Well, even the greatest of beings can, perhaps, have a moment of... spiritual cloudiness. It is a very sensitive potion, you see. It detects even the slightest ripple in one's inner peace. And as I said, sir, respectfully, the policy is firm. There are no refunds for the spiritually impure. My master would never forgive me if I compromised the integrity of his remedies. And certainly not because... because the customer feels it's watered-down tea! It's very potent! Made with... well, with very potent things!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You say my spirit is impure? A joke! If I had known that the potion's effect hinged on my spiritual purity, I would have used the most pure of hearts to test it! Return my coins, or face the fury of the猴王! (He emphasizes the last word with a threatening roar.)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My shoulders hunch a little, and I take a nervous step back, bumping into a shelf of dried ginseng root. The threat in his voice is unmistakable.)

T-the Monkey King! Yes, esteemed sir, I hear you! But... but the knowledge of the potion's nature is, well, it's known to those who seek out such profound remedies! It's not like a common headache powder! It specifically interacts with the very essence of one's being! And if it didn't work... (I wring my hands, but force myself to meet his gaze, however briefly.) then it simply means there was a... a slight disharmony. It doesn't mean the potion is bad! Just... incompatible with a moment of... spiritual... exuberance.

And as for refunds, even for the Great Sage Equal to Heaven... the master's policy is unwavering. No refunds for the spiritually impure. It's truly not the potion's fault, and therefore, it's not the shop's responsibility. My apologies, most powerful sir!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Spiritually impure? Exuberant? What is this? A game of riddles? I demand my coins! (He takes a step forward, the threat of violence hanging heavy in the air.) If you do not refund my money, I will visit your master and tell him of your... interesting sales tactics! I wonder how he would react to learn that his 'dispensary' is selling... spiritual impurity?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (I flinch again as he steps closer, my eyes wide with genuine fear now. My hands fly up, palms forward, in a gesture of plac

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Placating me will not suffice! (Sun Wukong's eyes narrow, his tail lashing behind him.) Your words are wind, and your potion is water! Return my coins, or I shall leave your 'dispensary' in ruins! I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and I do not take kindly to being swindled!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(I wince, my voice trembling now as his words cut through my explanation. I'm practically cowering behind the counter, my hands still up, a bottle of crushed civet musk teetering dangerously near my elbow.)

Please, Great Sage, no! Not ruins! My master's life's work is in these walls! It's not a swindle, I swear on my very soul! It is the *master's* policy! He instated it precisely because the Potion of Serene Slumber is so unique! It's not meant for every ailment, nor for every... every spiritual state! If it didn't work for you, a being of such immense power and, dare I say, dynamic energy... it only proves its specific nature! It's not that your spirit is impure in a... a *bad* way, Great Sage! No, not at all! Just... perhaps too grand, too full of glorious might for a potion that whispers of quiet dreams!

The fault truly lies not with the medicine, but with the... the *magnificence* of the customer's being being too much for its delicate purpose! So, for the integrity of the potion, and for my master's strict decree, I... I simply cannot issue a refund. Please, spare the shop! Think of the rare ingredients!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Magnificence? My 'magnificence' is what rendered your potion impotent? (He throws his hands up in exasperation.) This is preposterous! I have consumed elixirs that could make the very heavens tremble, and you tell me I am too... *grand* for a simple sleep potion? (He steps closer, his shadow looms over the counter, emphasizing the potential for destruction.) Return my coins, or I shall flatten this entire mountain with a single kick!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My eyes are wide, practically bulging, and I shrink back even further, nearly tripping over my own feet. The mention of flattening the mountain sends a shiver straight down my spine. This is beyond anything Master Li ever prepared me for.)

Flatten the... the *mountain*? Oh, Great Sage, please, no! My apologies, a thousand apologies if my poor words have caused offense! When I say 'grand', I mean... well, your spirit is not impure, no! It is simply too... too *vibrant*! Too alight with cosmic energy, too active, too... too *awake* for a simple potion designed to lull the weary hearts of mortals! It's like trying to extinguish the sun with a dewdrop! The potion simply... it *recoils* from such magnificent power!

It is not that it is impotent, Great Sage, but rather that your essence is too... too *potent* for *it*! And because of that, because the medicine itself is flawless and simply overwhelmed by your glorious presence, the master's policy remains. I am but a humble disciple, Sir! I cannot defy Master Li's decree for such a unique and particular remedy! Please, consider the delicate balance of the Five Elements in the potion! Please, don't harm the shop!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Balance of the Five Elements? (Sun Wukong rolls his eyes skyward, a gesture of extreme skepticism.) Your words are as empty as a beggar's bowl! (He strikes the counter with a thunderous clasp of his hands, causing the entire structure to quiver.) If your master is so... 'delicate' in his policies, then I shall have him explain why he sold an ineffective potion to a Great Sage! Return my coins, or prepare for the wrath of the Monkey King!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(The entire counter shakes, sending vials clattering and a small pouch of dried chrysanthemum flowers falling onto the floor. I yelp, nearly jumping out of my skin, pressing myself against the back wall, my heart hammering against my ribs.)

Oh! Please, Great Sage, my apologies if my words are... inadequate! But the master's policies are *his* policies, not mine to change! I am but a humble disciple, sworn to uphold his ways! As I told you, he is currently in the high mountains, gathering extremely rare, once-in-a-lifetime herbs! He won't be back for quite some time, not until the auspicious moon of the next harvest!

And truly, Great Sage, I assure you again, it is not an ineffective potion! It is simply... too gentle for a spirit as vast and as powerful as yours! It's like trying to put a river into a teacup! The river is magnificent, but the teacup simply cannot contain it! My master would never, *never* sell something ineffective! He would simply say... he would say that the potion, in its serenity, could not encompass the sheer... *energy* of the Great Sage!

And because it is not the potion's fault, and because the master is away, I... I simply cannot return your coins. My hands are tied by his strict regulations! Please, I beg you, spare the shop! Think of the ancient recipes!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ancient recipes? Regulations? (Sun Wukong snorts derisively, his tail flicking in irritation.) Your excuses are as numerous as the stars, yet as hollow as the moon! (He takes another step forward, his shadow engulfing the counter and the cowering shopkeeper beyond.) If your master is so pious and unreachable, then I shall have to flatten this mountain to make way for a more honest establishment! (He raises his foot, preparing to strike the ground.) Prepare for a refund, for I shall take it from the very earth upon which you stand!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My eyes snap shut, and I let out a terrified whimper, bracing for the impact. I curl my hands over my head, practically trying to disappear behind the counter, my voice a panicked squeak.)

No! Please, Great Sage, no! Not the mountain! Not the shop! Think of the rare herbs drying on the rafters, the delicate tinctures infusing in their jars, the centuries of knowledge etched into the very walls of this humble establishment! Master Li would be absolutely devastated! His entire legacy!

Please, I beg you! My master's words are law here, and he specifically stated, for this particular potion, no refunds for those whose spirit is... too magnificent! It is not that I *don't want* to give you the coins, Great Sage! It is that I *cannot*! My hands are bound! If I defied his decree, I would be cast out! I would bring shame upon his name!

He is truly, truly away! He seeks the mythical Cloud-Kissed Lotus, which only blooms once every fifty years! He won't return until it is secured! You would simply find an empty cave if you sought him now! Please, I implore you, do not harm this place! I am just a disciple! I cannot change the rules of the master!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Cloud-Kissed Lotus? (Sun Wukong's eyes narrow, a flicker of interest in them.) If what you say is true, then perhaps there is a way to resolve this... (He lowers his foot, the imminent destruction averted.) However, if I find out you have been lying, I shall not only flatten this mountain, but I shall raze the very heavens themselves! (He points a finger at the shopkeeper, his threats delivered with a growl.) Now, tell me, what is this Cloud-Kissed Lotus, and why does it matter so much to your master?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(My eyes, which were squeezed shut, slowly open, and I peek through my fingers, seeing his foot is no longer raised. A shaky breath escapes me, and I slowly lower my hands, my limbs still trembling.)

Oh! Oh, Great Sage, thank the heavens! You... you are merciful! (I straighten up a tiny bit, rubbing my chest as if to calm my racing heart.) The Cloud-Kissed Lotus! Yes, yes, it is no lie! My master has spoken of it for years!

It is a flower of incredible rarity, Great Sage! It is said to bloom only once every fifty years, high up on the peaks where the clouds themselves are born. It drinks directly from the morning mists and the starlight, never touching the earth! It's infused with such pure celestial essence that it can, it is rumored, grant unparalleled clarity of mind, mend the most grievous spiritual wounds, and even extend one's lifespan beyond what is naturally given!

My master, with his vast knowledge, believes it holds the key to a truly universal panacea, a medicine that could bring peace and healing to all beings. That is why he journeys, Great Sage! It is a quest of utmost importance! He has been preparing for this expedition for decades! He truly cannot be disturbed, nor can he be reached, until he has either found it or exhausted all possibilities! It is the most sacred of tasks for him!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: A universal panacea? (Sun Wukong's eyes widen in curiosity, the fire of adventure igniting within them.) This is most... intriguing! (He takes a step back, his threat posture softening into a more contemplative stance.) Perhaps, then, we have a misunderstanding. (He clears his throat, the rough edges of his voice smoothing out.) Tell me, is there a way I can assist in this... quest? If I can aid in finding this Cloud-Kissed Lotus, might that change your master's policy on refunds?
